questions.title: Before settlement, is half the capture a limit or the fixed amount?
questions.question: When a merchant refunds a charge that hasn't settled yet, should the card get what the merchant typed (up to half the capture), or always exactly half the capture, whatever they typed?

options.label: Half is a limit: on a $50 open charge, a $10 request returns $10
options.clarification: While a charge is not yet settled, the refund is the amount the merchant typed, up to half the captured amount (rounded down to the cent).

options.label: Always half: on a $50 open charge, a $10 request returns $25
options.clarification: While a charge is not yet settled, the refund is always half the captured amount (rounded down to the cent), whatever amount the merchant typed.
